ideas.title: Investigating the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme and its impact on vulnerable populations.
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and its impact on vulnerable populations. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue.

ideas.title: Cyberattacks on water systems: a growing concern
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent cyberattacks on water systems in the US and their impact on public safety and infrastructure security.
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a growing concern for public safety and infrastructure security. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the issue.
